settings.text: 2×6 tongue-and-groove walls and 2×4 bench framing. No heat or steam loss — even during cold winters.

settings.caption: Each of our saunas are built with
settings.heading: All-Natural Cedar
settings.text: Every Viking Sauna is built entirely from premium natural cedar — including the walls, benches, roof structure, trim, and flooring. Cedar is naturally resistant to moisture, decay, and insects, while also providing the rich aroma and warm aesthetic that defines a true traditional sauna experience.

settings.caption: Each of our saunas are
settings.heading: Built for the Outdoors
settings.text: Our saunas are engineered specifically for outdoor placement — not converted indoor kits. From the structural wall thickness to the roof design and floor system, each model is built to handle real-world outdoor environments including patios, decks, residential yards, and commercial settings. These are serious outdoor structures, not temporary enclosures.

settings.caption: The Viking way
settings.heading: Built to Last Generations
settings.text: The same spirit that drove Viking craftsmen to build ships that conquered oceans drives us to build saunas that outlast ordinary structures. Every joint, every board — built without compromise.

"The fit and finish is above what some might expect. The door has a self-closing hinge and fitted strips so no exposed end grain. The cradle uses pressure treated wood with red cedar above — just some of the little touches that show this team is not a cookie cutter cheap build. The sauna heats from 31 degrees to 170 in just under 30 minutes with a 6kw heater. I could not be more pleased."

— Steve, Ragnar 4-Person Outdoor Barrel Sauna

"After months of research I decided to purchase from Viking. After checking out their shop in person I knew I would be getting a quality product. Assembly was straightforward on my own — about 4 hours. The sauna gets up to 200 degrees within 40 mins. The wood is absolutely beautiful and the smell inside is fantastic. Overall a great purchase that looks absolutely beautiful in our backyard."

— Ryan

"I use my sauna every night! It's amazing, I still love the smell and the steam does so much for my overall health. I seem to sleep better when I use it. Thanks to the team at Viking Sauna!"
